name: Fiora Longears
objectiveText: Speak with Fiora Longears in Theramore.

comments.body: I'm only posting this because a player on my server was confused about boat routes - there is a boat directly from Menethil to Theramore. It departs Menethil on the dock opposite from the Auberdine boat.
This quest appears to no longer be in the game as of the Forever beta.
replies: Can confirm, I am unable to find Fiora Longears

There's a level 30 rated version available in the Forever beta. Not sure what the prerequisites are, but I found if after reaching level 30 as I was handing in https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=474/defeat-nekrosh and https://www.wowhead.com/forever/quest=98223/old-habits

comments.body: An NPC named Adam Lind will tell you if you are on the correct dock to Theramore.
Fiora Longears is in the inn at 66,45

She can be in found in the Inn in the northern part of Theramore.
Coordinates: 66, 45

NOW in Classic TBC, She is on the pier in Auberdine, I think she was part of a quest chain if you were coming to Kalimdor FROM the Eastern Kingdoms, she would send you on to Astranaar In Ashenvale.

 I as a night elf, finished in Darnassus questing etc, got the boat to Auberdine and ran past her but then stopped and picked up her quest to get the venom sacs from 1000 needles and to take them to (herself in Theramore Inn, Theramore Island in Dustwallow marsh.) As I never took notice of her name at the time it never clicked.

So after a long while I eventually got down to 1000 needles and got the venom sacs and took them to Theramore Island, searching and searching I couldnt find her to hand in the quest, thats when i went on line looking and came here, and elsewhere, and found she had been moved to Auberdine.

So I thought oh! and flew back to Auberdine and she was there where i picked up the quest with a yellow question mark, so handed it in.

It seems she is/was part of a quest chain originally in ordinary WOW, but in classic TBC, becomes a single quest you start and end with her in Auberdine. the PROBLEM is the wording in the quest window about going to Theramore, it should say returm to "herself" HERE.

hope this clears it up for people wondering whats going on... and yes, her wine looks like it has set and stuck in her wineglass..heh! heh!

comments.body: How do u know the coordinates?

After installing Cosmos, and each time you get into WoW, you hit 'enter' to bring up the chat dialogue and then type    /tloc    and press 'enter'... this should bring up map coordinates... note: each time you login, you have to do this.  Hope that helps.
